issue.body:
Close #23680

Some CLI programs use "\r" and control chars to print new content in current line.

So, the strings in one line are actually from `\rReading...1%\rReading...5%\rReading...100%`

This PR tries to make the output better.

body: I guess #23820 could help (I haven't tried). Could you take a look? Thank you.

> Gitea assembles the content, only renders the last "Reading...100%\n".

Also prefer this if line deletions can be reliably detected and removed, e.g. just render it like a terminal would after modifications are completed on the line.

> It seems that the process state icon's location is also strange. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18380374/227450917-b165d47d-5796-4f5a-a08f-1972a634b94d.png)

I think https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/23789 has fixed that alignment.

> I think https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/23789 has fixed that alignment.

Yes, it fixed in #23789

Wait, keep it open.

The key problem (line number) hasn't been fixed.  #23789 only improves some alignments.
